title: Custom types
lead: Your own item types for text: content and its language, like a snippet. They show in the sidebar below the built-in types.
empty: You have no custom types yet.
locked: Custom types are a Pro feature.
lockedWithTypes: Your plan no longer includes custom types. They stay as they are, and you can delete them.

form.createDescription: Pick a name, an icon and a color. The address of its page is made from the name and stays the same when you rename it.
form.editDescription: Renaming keeps the address of its page and its items.
form.name: Name

delete.title: Delete this type?
